symbols.limits: reads/writes: the component views in the parameters of the system's exported methods. uses: the component operations (add, remove, get, has) its per-frame update performs through the engine's out-of-line helpers, itself or in a function it calls (depth 2), with the call site; kind index: a matched method reads the type's index and the operation is not known. Not listed: operations the compiler inlined, those deeper than depth 2, and what a method that is not the update does (e.g. a SystemLoad) - read its pseudo-code; an empty writes list is not "writes nothing".

does.text: The system keeps a list of pending swap requests (entries of 0x18 bytes: two entities and a FixedString). Each update it keeps the entries whose both entities pass a validity test (bg3_dx11.exe+0xF1C590, not read), drops duplicates, and releases the list. If any entry was kept it creates one new entity and gives it esv::swap_places::RequestOneFrameComponent (the kept requests copied into Requests), eoc::swap_places::AnimationRequestComponent (the same entries copied into its Requests) and esv::swap_places::LifetimeComponent with Lifetime = 4.0. Mechanic: Benign Transposition (Target_BenignTransposition_Teleport) swaps the caster and an ally; this is its request becoming a short-lived swap entity.
does.evidence: bg3_dx11.exe+0x2E9E5F0 (read as ProcessSwapPlacesRequests: the only caller of the three component adders bg3_dx11.exe+0x2E9F7E0, +0x2E9F960, +0x2E9F670): the validity loop at the top, the create-entity call (bg3_dx11.exe+0x4017CE0, read as create by its use: an entity handle is written through its second argument and the three adds go to it), the three adders identified by the type ids they use (gatekit decomp code on each), and the 4.0f (0x40800000) stored at +8 of the Lifetime component in bg3_dx11.exe+0x2E9F670.
does.check_note: appears x3: yes (the recipe passes for each type on world). Lifetime = 4.0 at creation is not checkable live: equals reads at the end of the steps, two seconds after the cast, and whether Lifetime counts down was not read. 'All three on one new entity' cannot be said: the verbs look at types, not at one entity created during the recipe (entity takes a uuid known before).
